points: Flash Eurobarometer 3696: about 12,800 interviews with heads of firms with 1 to 749 staff in all 27 EU countries, March to April 2026
42% use AI or algorithmic management, 21% more plan to; top uses: customer service 47%, performance monitoring 36%, staff scheduling 30%
49% do not trust AI for staff decisions; barriers are investment cost 50%, legal uncertainty 49%, lack of expertise 48%
read: Flash Eurobarometer 3696 on AI and algorithmic management, 14.10.2026
take: The Commission's own survey feeds the coming Quality Jobs Act. HR and works-council talks on AI-based performance monitoring and scheduling should start before the rules do.
title: Eurobarometer: 42% of EU SMEs and mid-caps already use AI
